In [[mathematics]], '''Abel–Goncharov interpolation''' determines a [[polynomial]] such that various higher derivatives are the same as those of a given [[Function (mathematics)|function]] at given points. It was introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Whittaker|authorlink=John Macnaghten Whittaker|year=1935}} and rediscovered by {{harvs|txt|last=Goncharov|year=1954}}.
